raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. rage , keberangan, keradangan; be in a ~, sedang /berang, radang/; fly into a ~, naik /berang, radang/; 2. violence , keganasan; ( of battle ) kemarakan: the ship was caught in the ~ of the storm , kapal itu terperangkap dlm keganasan ribut; like ~, ( colloq ) macam ribut: he ran like ~ to escape the fire , dia lari macam ribut hendak lepaskan diri drpd kebakaran itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
